## `GET /hosts`

Lists hosts.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                         |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [HostResource](/reference/api/models/#hostresource) |

## `POST /hosts`

Registers a host: a GPU machine outside Kubernetes, with its price.

**Request body:** [HostCreate](/reference/api/models/#hostcreate) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                |
| ------ | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`  | Successful Response | [HostResource](/reference/api/models/#hostresource) |

## `DELETE /hosts/{host_id}`

Refused (409) while a managed target names the host.

| Parameter | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `host_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `GET /hosts/{host_id}`

Returns one host.

| Parameter | In   | Type     | Required | Description |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |

## `POST /hosts/{host_id}/read-machine`

Read the machine through the launcher of a host target on it (GET /machine) and keep it as the host's hardware. 422 when no host target names the host.

| Parameter | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `host_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [HostResource](/reference/api/models/#hostresource)               |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |
